title: Lizzie Miles as a school friend, and her husband Pajot
summary: Dominique went to school with Lizzie Landry (Lizzie Miles), brought her to Chicago, and recalls her husband and meeting her again.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives
